title: Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B (NVIDIA NIM)
notes: 24-hour autonomous run on omp via NVIDIA NIM (19 commits, 6,386 tool calls, 2.29B total tokens / 2.26B cached). Stayed on the 1996 SGI IDO C89 compiler and original Fast3D microcode for the entire run without switching to GCC -O2 or F3DEX2, focusing on manual C micro-optimizations (register hints, jump-table dispatch in geo_process_node_and_siblings, precomputed collision deltas, matrix temporaries, and clear_spatial_partition loop tuning). Best valid 25-route checkpoint (9ceb56e, 23.7 h) scores 1.053x section-weighted (1.053x flat, 0.770x vs GCC -O2) and passes the PLAY=1 console boot smoke; the final commit (5f11847) failed SGI IDO C89 compilation in behavior_script.c.
